item.tib: dpal ldan lha mo yang snying gi rgyud las las kyi gshin rje'i sgrub gzhung gnam lcags thog mda'
item.coloph: de ldar gshin rje ya ma ra dza yi/ sgrub gzhung gnam lcags thog mda' bya ba 'di/ drin can mtshungs med dam pa'i bka' nyan dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa ni/ bla ma yi dam rnams la mthol lo bshags/ mkha' 'gro bon skyongs rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
